gw_in_hy2.apps: Apps with Hysteria2: v2RayTun, Hiddify, Karing, v2rayN.
gw_in_hy2.err.hop_bad: Port hopping: a range like 20000-20099 is needed, got {value}.
gw_in_hy2.err.hop_many: Port hopping: the range has {n} ports, {max} at the most.
gw_in_hy2.err.hop_range: Port hopping: the ports of the range are from {lo} to {hi}.
gw_in_hy2.err.not_user: The device «{device}» has no Hysteria2 — turn it on in the device’s access.
gw_in_hy2.err.xray_old: Hysteria2 needs xray {need} or newer; this one is {have}.
gw_in_hy2.link_private: The link is this device’s key: do not send it to others.
gw_in_hy2.log.rekey: a new self-signed certificate — the links given out must be issued again
gw_in_hy2.log.tls_failed: the certificate for Hysteria2 was not written: {error}
gw_in_hy2.qr_note: Scan the QR code in an app with Hysteria2 (import from QR or from the clipboard).
gw_in_hy2.route_note: The device’s traffic follows its route, as with VLESS.
gw_in_hy2.self_note: No domain — a self-signed certificate: the link carries its fingerprint (pinSHA256). Some apps check only «insecure: yes» and accept any certificate. A domain is safer.
gw_in_hy2.udp_note: Hysteria2 runs over UDP (QUIC). If it does not connect on a mobile network, use VLESS.
gw_in_hy2.warn.idle: no device has Hysteria2 — the first one connects without a restart
gw_in_hy2.warn.not_listening: Port {port}/udp is not listening — Hysteria2 takes no connections.
gw_in_hy2.warn.self_cert: No domain — a self-signed certificate. Some apps check only «insecure: yes» and accept any certificate. A domain is safer.
gw_in_hy2.warn.xray_down: The gateway xray is not running — Hysteria2 does not work.
